<!doctype html><html lang="es"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="theme-color" content="#252628"><title>UPARTE</title><style>
:root{--paper:#f3efe7;--ink:#242422;--muted:#7d776d;--anth:#252628;--gold:#d3aa5f;--line:rgba(36,36,34,.14);--space:#202126;--sea:#e7ece9}*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;font-family:"Avenir img{width:min(77vw,330px);height:auto}.intro h2{font-size:clamp(40px,7vw,68px);letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:300;text-transform:uppercase;margin:15px 0 9px}.head p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.space .head img{width:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain;background:#f3efe7}.meta{padding:16px}.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px}small{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}.card h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:7px 0}.card p{font-size:11px;color:#676158;line-height:1.55}.space .card p{color:#cfc9c0}.price{font-size:18px}.status{font-size:8px;text-transform:uppercase}.detail{padding:36px 5vw 110px}.detailgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr
